name: flat
label: Flat
css: .style-flat { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: flex-start; width: 1080px; height: 1080px; padding: 64px; background-color: var(--surface, #FFFFFF); font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; position: relative; overflow: hidden; } .style-flat .hook { font-size: 80px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.1; color: var(--text, #111827); margin: 0; max-width: 90%; word-wrap: break-word; } .style-flat .text { font-size: 50px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; color: var(--text, #111827); margin: 0; max-width: 85%; word-wrap: break-word; } .style-flat .step { position: absolute; top: 64px; right: 64px; font-size: 160px; font-weight: 900; color: var(--text, #111827); opacity: 0.08; margin: 0; line-height: 1; } .style-flat .brand { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text, #111827); margin: 0; letter-spacing: 0.5px; } .style-flat::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 4px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--slide-primary, #F2673C) 0%, var(--slide-primary, #F2673C) 100%); } .slide-code.style-flat { background-color: var(--text, #111827); } .slide-code.style-flat .hook { color: var(--surface, #FFFFFF); } .slide-code.style-flat .text { color: var(--surface, #FFFFFF); } .slide-code.style-flat .brand { color: var(--surface, #FFFFFF); } .slide-code.style-flat .step { color: var(--surface, #FFFFFF); opacity: 0.12; } .slide-code.style-flat::before { background: var(--slide-primary, #F2673C); } .slide-insight.style-flat { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--text, #111827) 0%, #1a1a2e 100%); } .slide-insight.style-flat .hook { color: var(--slide-primary, #F2673C); } .slide-insight.style-flat .text { color: var(--surface, #FFFFFF); } .slide-insight.style-flat .brand { color: var(--surface, #FFFFFF); } .slide-insight.style-flat .step { color: var(--surface, #FFFFFF); opacity: 0.15; } .slide-insight.style-flat .insight-text { font-size: 32px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--surface, #FFFFFF); line-height: 1.4; background-color: rgba(242, 103, 60, 0.12); padding: 24px; border-left: 4px solid var(--slide-primary, #F2673C); margin-top: 16px; }
